newsitem.title: UK: European naphtha notionally firmer with crude.
newsitem.headline: European naphtha notionally firmer with crude.

text.p: European naphtha prices were mostly firmer on the back of crude which was lifted by the threat of further sanctions by the United Nations against Iraq.
However, traders said the spot price gains were mostly notional with relaxed buying interest keeping bids low while term contract pricing strategies kept offers high.
In NWE pipeline spec cargoes offered around mean of published quotes +$1.25 to +$1.50 found little buying interest.

In the Mediterranean Moroccan barrels were still seen available at what some traders said was a high, pricing related, offer of $177 a tonne and expected to see little buying interest for the material.
